\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{scope}[shift={(5pt,7pt)},rotate=90,xscale=2]
    \clip (-5pt,-6pt) rectangle (9pt,8pt);
    \draw (1pt,2pt) -- (4pt,2pt);
    \begin{scope}[xshift=3pt,on background layer={yshift=4pt}]
      \draw (1pt,2pt) -- (4pt,2pt);
    \end{scope}
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[transform canvas={shift={(30pt,40pt)}}]
    \draw (2pt,1pt) -- (6pt,4pt);
    \begin{pgfonlayer}{background}
      \draw (2pt,1pt) -- (6pt,4pt);
    \end{pgfonlayer}
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[on background layer]
    \begin{scope}
      \clip (12pt,1pt) rectangle (18pt,5pt);
      \fill (10pt,0pt) rectangle (20pt,6pt);
    \end{scope}
    \fill (11pt,7pt) rectangle (21pt,10pt);
    \clip (22pt,1pt) rectangle (28pt,5pt);
    \fill[fill=red] (20pt,0pt) rectangle (30pt,6pt);
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[on background layer]
    \fill[fill=blue] (24pt,0pt) rectangle (31pt,6pt);
  \end{scope}
  \fill[fill=green] (19pt,-3pt) rectangle (32pt,0pt);
\end{tikzpicture}
